preconditions.description: The length of the array is between 1 and 1000.
Each element of the array is between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.description: The number of pairs m is either -1 (indicating no such list exists) or a non-negative integer up to n(n-1)/2.

postconditions.expression: Q1 and (m == -1 or (all(u_i < v_i for i in range(m)) and all(a[u_i-1] > a[v_i-1] for i in range(m)) and is_sorted(a)))
postconditions.description: If m is not -1, then for each pair (u_i, v_i) in the list, u_i < v_i, the pair forms an inversion in the array a, and after processing all pairs, the array a is sorted in non-decreasing order.
